description:
Three different couples, three unique love stories—each beginning in their own unexpected way.

Song Kichan & An Hyejin
A battle of pride started by a petty argument. Wait… did they just accidentally start dating?! A classic friends-to-lovers romance.

Seo Kijun & Shin Ahyoung
After passing out after a night of drinking, Kijun wakes up with more than one gap in his memory. First, how did he get home? And second, why is one of his classmates lying in bed with him? What happened last night?!

Ha Taewook & Yang Hyein
An exciting first date! And what better to bring two young lovebirds closer together than a cafe pager? A heartwarming love story between a girl with an explosive libido and a pure-hearted boy.

(Source: Lezhin US)
